browser_integration.description: DDMM registers itself with your browsers so the extension can hand off downloads to it. This happens automatically on launch; use Repair if a browser stops recognizing DDMM (for example after moving the app).

updates.title: Mod updates
updates.description: Update checks never run unless you ask: click Check for Updates on the Mods page, or turn on automatic checks here.

auto_check.label: Check for mod updates when DDMM starts
auto_check.description: Off by default. Checks only contact the sites your mods came from, and never download or install anything by themselves. Nexus Mods mods are only checked when you click Check for Updates.

nexus.title: Nexus Mods (optional)
nexus.description: Optional. Only used to check your Nexus Mods mods for updates. Sign in, or enter a personal API key, or do neither: everything else in DDMM works the same.
nexus.where_to_get: On Nexus Mods, open your account's API Keys page (Get a key), copy the Personal API Key at the bottom, and paste it here. DDMM checks it with Nexus before saving. Remove it here any time.
nexus.placeholder: Paste your personal Nexus Mods API key

open_page_button.tip: Open the API Keys page of your Nexus Mods account in your browser

nexus.connected_unknown: A Nexus Mods API key is saved.
nexus.stored_keychain: Stored in your system's keychain (credential store), not in DDMM's settings.
nexus.stored_file: No system keychain was available, so the key is stored as a file readable only by you (nexus-api-key in DDMM's data folder).
nexus.privacy: Nexus is only contacted when you click Check for Updates, Sign in, Sign out, or Save & verify, never by automatic checks. Your sign-in and key are only sent to Nexus Mods (users.nexusmods.com and api.nexusmods.com) over HTTPS, and aren't written to settings.json or logs.

button.tip: Opens Nexus Mods in your browser, where you approve DDMM. Optional.

sign_in.coming_soon_tip: Signing in to Nexus Mods isn't available in this version yet. You can enter a personal API key below instead.
sign_in.waiting: Waiting for you to approve DDMM in your browser... This stops after 5 minutes.
sign_in.signed_in: Signed in to Nexus Mods as {name}.
sign_in.stored_keychain: Your sign-in is stored in your system's keychain (credential store), not in DDMM's settings.
sign_in.stored_file: No system keychain was available, so your sign-in is stored as a file readable only by you (nexus-oauth-tokens in DDMM's data folder).
sign_in.key_not_used: While you're signed in, your personal API key below is kept but not used.

data_folder_move.title: Move Data Folder
data_folder_move.subfolder_note: {picked} already has other files in it, so DDMM will keep its data in a new "DDMM Data" folder inside it instead of mixing them.
data_folder_move.step_copy: DDMM copies your mods, settings, profiles and logs to the new folder.
data_folder_move.step_verify: It checks that every file arrived complete.
data_folder_move.step_switch: It switches to the new folder.
data_folder_move.step_delete: Only then does it delete the old copy.
data_folder_move.step_restart: DDMM restarts using the new folder.
data_folder_move.failure_note: If anything goes wrong, the partial copy is removed and your data stays where it is. Mod operations are paused until DDMM restarts.
data_folder_move.adopt_message: {target} already holds DDMM data (mods, settings or profiles). Use the existing data there?
data_folder_move.adopt_detail: DDMM will switch to that folder and restart. Nothing is copied or deleted: your current data stays in {source}.

data_folder_progress.title: Moving Data Folder

data_folder_progress.dont_close: Please don't close DDMM until this finishes.

browser_update.waiting: Waiting for the update from your browser...

import.title: Import Mods
import.intro: Bring over the mods you already have, all at once: from another mod manager, or from a folder of downloaded archives. Nothing is downloaded, and the original files are only read, never changed or moved.
import.looking: Looking for mods on this PC...
import.none_found: No other mod manager's mods were found in the usual places on this PC. Choose the folder where your mods or downloaded archives are.

source.manager_mods: Mods installed with another mod manager
source.manager_downloads: Archives downloaded by another mod manager

import.folder_hint: Any folder works: another mod manager's mods folder, or a folder with hundreds of .zip/.7z/.rar files (subfolders are searched too). You'll see a list to pick from before anything is imported.
import.nothing_found: No mods found there. Pick the folder that holds the mod folders or the downloaded archives.
import.summary: {total} found: {new} new, {installed} already in DDMM, {other} skipped.
import.truncated: That folder holds a lot; only the first 5000 items are listed. Pick a more specific folder to see the rest.
import.linkable: {count} mods you already have will get their Nexus Mods info added, so update checks cover them. Nothing else about them changes.
import.linkable_one: 1 mod you already have will get its Nexus Mods info added, so update checks cover it. Nothing else about it changes.

status.installed_add_source: Already in DDMM ("{name}"): will add Nexus info

import.add_to_profile: Also add them to the profile "{profile}"
import.keeps_order: Keeps the load order, on/off state and chosen options from "{profile}".
import.keeps_order_unnamed: Keeps the load order, on/off state and chosen options the other mod manager had.
import.read_only_note: The originals stay where they are; DDMM copies what it imports into its own mods folder.
import.done_linked: Added Nexus Mods info to {count} mods you already had.
import.done_linked_one: Added Nexus Mods info to 1 mod you already had.
import.done_cancelled: Cancelled: {count} mods weren't imported. Run the import again to get them; what's already imported is recognized and skipped.
import.done_cancelled_one: Cancelled: 1 mod wasn't imported. Run the import again to get it; what's already imported is recognized and skipped.
import.done_rolled_back: "{name}", which was being imported, was removed again.
import.done_warnings: {count} have no Helldivers 2 patch files and won't change anything when deployed.
import.done_warnings_one: 1 has no Helldivers 2 patch files and won't change anything when deployed.
